flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3002/app then Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00".
Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".

remark: wait: Waiting stop because the top-up click did not reach the target

summary:
The agent aimed at the wrong on-screen location. The screenshot marker is above the quota card rather than on “+ Top Up Quota ($250)”.
Correct the mouse targeting/element-bound calculation for the Top Up Quota control, then rerun from the seeded state without dismissing or working around any overlay.
one_liner: The automated mouse click landed above the Top Up Quota control, so the required user-style click was not completed.
reason: The click missed the target, and constraints forbid waiting or workaround actions.

verdict.root_cause: The agent aimed at the wrong on-screen location. The screenshot marker is above the quota card rather than on “+ Top Up Quota ($250)”.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome by issuing the mouse click at an incorrect screen position. The target was visibly available after the initial quota checks, while the recorded click marker is above it. The cookie notice did not cover the target. Although a top-up API request returned 200, that does not prove that this required physical click reached the visible control or that the required final UI state was achieved.
verdict.bug_title: Top-up click used coordinates above the target
verdict.suggestion: Correct the mouse targeting/element-bound calculation for the Top Up Quota control, then rerun from the seeded state without dismissing or working around any overlay.
